history.content: ok so this is silly but my sourdough starter FINALLY came alive today after like 8 days of nothing lol. just wanted to put that somewhere
That’s a lovely thing to put somewhere. Eight days of nothing, and then it finally came alive, that feels worth marking.

yeah!! i kept feeding it and feeding it and nothing and i almost dumped it yesterday honestly. and then this morning i lifted the towel and it had like DOUBLED. all bubbly. felt like such a dumb little win but i actually did a little dance in my kitchen lol
Not dumb at all, it sounds like a real little win, and a bit of relief too.
ya the relief is real lol. i named it Doughbert. anyway im gonna go bake something with it before it deflates, just wanted to mark it. thanks :)
Doughbert is a great name, and I’m glad you marked it here. Go enjoy the bake.
haha will do. bye Doughbert needs me 🍞
Bye, and have fun with Doughbert.
